rules.source: Approved full Pro Architecture Governance V1.1 F4 and accompanying F6, inline architecture-work-handoff-cd36f84. Preserve one original page-level unknown command coordinator, upload recovery, original quantities/versions/roles/UI and PERF01-12. User authorizes independent PR/Codex Review/sequential merge, no deployment/live data/configuration/schema/dependency changes. F1 and actual F2 merged baseline retained. F4 native/behavior checks were executed on the identical F2-candidate+F4 source before the history-only actual release merge; recorded input/source hashes must match, not a claim of rerunning those tests after the merge. Backend boardRead/quantityRead and frontend pageRead assertions in global-style-search coexist and passed in combined105. Complete authorized matching-set totals, whole-time style search and full export retain original date/status/exact-batch permission contracts; current15 is only display paging.
rules.initialization: Original filters/page/debounce/ready/error/current-role effect/expanded rows move into useReceivingBoardRead. Plain types preserve original null/quantity/revision shape. Page still owns original display, export orchestration and ReceivingDialog. Original3 effects are exactly unchanged by private AST comparison; stale success/error/finally follow original active cleanup, no business POST cancellation. Exact receivingBatchId/invalid target and validated returnTo stay at original page entry. No global cache, persistent draft or shared auth result saved.
rules.dateAndPermission: Original Shanghai local date and native API parameters retained; ranges/search semantics, full server KPI and unknown values unchanged. Current original verifySession/moduleCanWrite/warehouse role and Root/merch permission conditions move intact, not replaced with client role strings. Production App native tests use original signed AuthService/PostgresAuthStore/Acceptance TEST provider, separate Root and warehouse contexts; no fake AuthUser. Existing API/clock/quantity/financial rules untouched.
rules.expectation: Dynamic same-instance A-B-A rejects old read success/failure without clearing latest ready state. Native original App exact-batch context and return link, hidden filters, warehouse-only controls and no Root/merch actions pass. Native3 is isolated TEST historical-receipt data, no onsite claim. Page return markup is exactly equal except naming the original image cleanup handler; no CSS, App routing or lazy component identity changes.

Existing expectedVersion/document/actual/packingRevision fields and original non-idempotent command headers preserved. New helper references the same page dispatch for post-confirmation read; already confirmed POST is not rerun on GET failure. Server authorization and local Role gates stay original. Recovery is reachable in native modal and after close, editing protections remain. No new upload, public attachment permission or historical rewrite.
rules.expectation: New React/real-coordinator test closes an unknown packing dialog, refuses another row, and replays original body/key after local field edits. URL test proves only own selected URLs released on remove/close/unmount. Native App actually commits packing/difference in PG before injected receipt503, recovery sends exact same body/key and database contains exactly1 revision/resolution. Native GET-only refresh leaves original pending dialog/command. Existing14 synthetic original dialog feedback cases at390/1440 pass separately (Chromium151/TEST HTTP), not called native PG or same-browser-version evidence.
